instructions: 1. Say to your AI which status to list (draft, approved, scheduled, posted or failed) and give it the person's post records.
2. The AI calls tool:list-posts-by-status with status and records.
3. Read what comes back: posts, each with post_id, status, scheduled_for and caption.
